result:
The fix is merged and verified. PR #13 landed on `main`, issue #12 auto-closed via "Closes #12", and re-running the acceptance checks against the updated default branch passes.

**final_report**

- **what_broke:** `format_output` in `fixture_multimod/formatters.py` returned `json.dumps(data)` without a trailing newline in json mode, while text mode ended with `\n`. Because `cli.py` prints with `end=""` and both `summarize` and `report` share the formatter through `core.py`, both commands emitted an unterminated last line in json mode.
- **what_changed:** The implementation role (spawned on issue #12, delivered as [PR #13](https://github.com/JiwonJung94/northpole-harness-fixture/pull/13), now merged) changed the json branch to `json.dumps(data) + "\n"` — one shared-site fix covering both commands, with the text branch untouched.
- **what_became_possible:** Both commands now emit newline-terminated json output, so shell pipelines and line-oriented consumers see a well-formed last line. Verified on updated main: `pytest` 2 passed, and both `summarize --mode json` and `report --mode json` end with exactly one `\n` while text mode is unchanged (`b'{"count": 2}\n'`, `b'{"items": ["a", "b"]}\n'`).
- **what_limits_remain:** The repo has no CI, so "checks passed" means the issue's acceptance checks run locally, not a pipeline. The `watch --follow` process from the previous session was stopped without a record, so completion was picked up from the roster and PR state rather than a live event.

Board-wise, one condition now technically matches: an executable artifact landed on `main` with no `execution-observation` record for that commit. Since I already exercised the merged behavior directly (output above), spawning that role would mostly formalize the same observation on the board — say the word if you want that record written.
